heldout_truth_npz.withheld_events: entry/exit states, event time, mode, and impulse
heldout_truth_npz.withheld_sequence: one independent full event sequence or full cycle

metadata_json: schema version and physical model identifier
parameter values, priors, and source citations

driver_and_boundary_gates.ledger_identity: C b equals integrated distributed source plus outer/inner boundary ledger rate
driver_and_boundary_gates.outer_projection: physical exterior state/flux is projected onto the eleven certified incoming outward-normal entropy characteristics
driver_and_boundary_gates.phase_periodicity: values and first derivatives close at 0/2*pi

event_truth_acquisition.reset_fit: DeltaQ_event and a ledger-null constitutive jump are fit separately; the certified weighted reset geometry enforces the ledger exactly
event_truth_acquisition.truth_unit: one offline entry-to-exit physical solve with dense guard localization and complete integrated face/source/constraint ledgers

fail_fast_acquisition_order: validate external physical model metadata and phase law
acquire outer loading and distributed source ledgers on a sparse phase grid
continue one cold branch sheet and validate prospective cold holdouts
continue hot/cooling/recovery sheets only after the cold sheet passes
acquire each event class independently and validate event holdouts immediately
build the full adaptive atlas only after all sparse preflights pass
run one heldout event sequence or cycle only after the atlas is frozen

offline_branch_problem.continuation: bordered pseudo-arclength in (q,phi) with adaptive arclength, fold crossing, exact residual correction, and accepted-anchor-only history
offline_branch_problem.coordinates: (z,q,phi,m) with z in R^1232 and q=Cz in R^4
offline_branch_problem.fold_policy: fold or stability loss becomes a physical guard candidate, not extrapolation
offline_branch_problem.normal_hyperbolicity: all eliminated fast eigenvalues strictly stable and separated from retained rates by at least the prospectively frozen gap ratio
offline_branch_problem.stationarity: P_fast(z,q,phi,m) F_physical(z,q,phi,m)=0 with C z=q and physical boundary/source constraints

prospective_holdouts.branch: at least 20 percent of anchors, including fold-adjacent anchors
prospective_holdouts.events: at least 20 percent per event class and one parameter-edge sample
prospective_holdouts.leakage: hash-lock all split indices before the first coefficient fit
prospective_holdouts.phase: at least two contiguous phase windows absent from all fits
prospective_holdouts.sequence: one complete event sequence or cycle never used for fitting
prospective_holdouts.spatial: one independently generated native-grid or refined-grid truth comparison

constitutive_cycle_closure: physical transition guards with crossing orientation
distributed_sources: rest-mass injection rate and native radial profile
specific angular momentum of injected material
specific total energy/entropy of injected material
tidal work and torque if present
wind mass, angular-momentum, and energy loss if present
orbital_ephemeris: phase phi(t) on S1 and strictly positive phase rate
physical period and its parameter provenance
impact geometry and orientation relative to the disk
outer_environment: physical exterior primitive/entropy state or incoming flux law
all eleven incoming entropy-characteristic amplitudes at the outer edge

scientific_boundary.certified_short_time_model_scope: no tide, no wind, no hot-state/S-curve cycle closure, static prefix exterior candidate, and 0.016 seconds of revealed dynamics
scientific_boundary.fiducial_period_role: runtime target only until a physical orbital/driver model supplies and validates the phase law
scientific_boundary.forbidden_inference: the 6.7-day target, 16-ms prefix, or old static exterior state may not be promoted into cycle-wide physical forcing
